content: pdfTeX and LuaTeX honor SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for CreationDate/ModDate and trailer /ID; FORCE_SOURCE_DATE=1 also pins \today primitives. Locally verified 2026-09-29 on MiKTeX 23.10.12 LuaHBTeX 1.17.0: two lualatex runs with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH produce byte-identical PDFs (same sha256), two runs without it differ.
